name: elevated single leg bridge
description: A single-leg glute bridge with your feet raised. It strongly works the glutes and hamstrings.
instructions: Lie on your back with one foot raised on a bench or step.
Extend the other leg straight up.
Drive through your heel and lift your hips.
Squeeze your glute at the top without arching your back.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch legs.
